messages:
claire_pm: Quick thread to land the rollout play for routing-fallbacks. Need: feature flag conventions, experiment gating, canary vs AB decision criteria, region ordering, and a clear rollback ladder. Aim: ship to hosted + dedicated, hold private behind KMS/contract.

priya_support: +1. Support asks for a customer opt-in flow and canned comms. Also request a way to opt-out per-tenant quickly.

tom_eng: Proposed rollout: 1) non-impact shadow traffic for 60m 2) 0.5% canary for 30m 3) 5% ramp for 90m 4) 25% progressive across 6h. Regions: start us-west-2 -> eu-west-1 -> us-east-1.

ana_sre: small correction: ana_sre here. Add a pre-roll SRE dry-run (no real traffic) to validate KV priming + cache warmup to avoid cold start spikes. Also require a cool-down window between region pushes.

lucas_data: For decisions between A/B and canary: A/B for user-perceived metrics only (CTR, retention proxies). Canary for infra and latency. Keep cohorts disjoint and do not double-expose the same user.

devops: Flag naming: prefer dotted names with versioning: ff.routing_fallbacks.v1.enabled, ff.routing_fallbacks.v1.slice_pct, ff.routing_fallbacks.v1.scope.[global|region|tenant]. Also add ff.routing_fallbacks.v1.emergency_off. Example: {"ff.routing_fallbacks.v1.enabled": true, "ff.routing_fallbacks.v1.slice_pct": 1} (we'll store as typed config).

ana_sre: Telemetry gates: require no regression or small delta for these: p95 latency delta <= 12%, error rate delta <= 0.15% absolute, fallback_invocations <= 2x baseline. Host CPU <= 75%. If any gate trips for 10m, auto soft-roll to previous snapshot (slice_pct->0.1%).

claire_pm: What's the rollback ladder? I want deterministic steps we can read out to customers.

ana_sre: Ladder: 1) Auto soft -> reduce slice_pct to 0.1% (automated) 2) Tenant-level kill (automated if tenant breaches thresholds) 3) Region rollback (manual with on-call approval) 4) Global kill-switch (manual exec). Add a 15m cooldown before re-trying.

tom_eng: We'll implement a dry-run toggle that exercises the codepath without changing real routing; it's useful for shiproom. Also will log full traces for sampled requests during 0.5% and 5% windows (PII sanitized).

lucas_data: We'll provide a lightweight experiment dashboard showing: slice_pct, p50/p95/p99, error-rate, reroute-rate, fallback-invocations, and a small cohort table (region/tenant slices). Prefers 1m resolution.

priya_support: Please include a customer-facing status blurb template and a short FAQ for opt-ins. Support wants a webhook when a tenant-level kill is triggered.

devops: We can expose a webhook and admin UI. Audit logs will record toggles with user and timestamp. We'll also attach an ops-bot Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-12022 for automation + RI-12023 for dashboard.

claire_pm: A few open items: 1) Confirm EU data/KMS gating for Private 2) Decide exact sampling fraction for trace capture 3) Finalize bake times for 5%->25% ramp.

ana_sre: For EU KMS: Private won't go live until customer-managed keys are validated. Add legal sign-off step.

lucas_data: Suggest trace sampling: 100% of canary requests for 0.5% window (since volume small), then 5% sampling at 5% window. That balances signal and privacy.

tom_eng: For 5%->25% ramp: propose doubling cadence: 5% for 90m, 10% for 90m, 25% after stable 3h. We're trying to reduce oscillation.

claire_pm: OK. Action items: tom -> dry-run PR + rollout script, devops -> flag + webhook + audit logs, ana_sre -> gate automation + rollback ladder, lucas -> dashboard + sampling plan, priya -> customer comms + opt-in flow. I'll schedule sign-off after dry-run next week.

ops-bot: RI-12022 assigned: tom_eng, devops, ana_sre. Dry-run scheduled 2026-04-02T09:00:00Z.

claire_pm: Thanks all. DM me if anything blocks. :ok_hand:
